basic_info.description: Situated on a coveted block of Page Street at the intersection of Hayes Valley and Duboce Triangle, this spacious condo is ideally located near some of the best shopping, dining, nightlife and culture that the city has to offer.  Behind the handsome Edwardian faade you'll find a fully renovated flat that has been redesigned for modern living while still retaining many period details and vintage charm. The sunny south facing formal living room features a decorative fireplace, pocket doors, coved ceilings and bay windows with views of Twin Peaks. It would also make an ideal WFH office/guest space. Past the living room you'll find two spacious bedrooms, both en-suite. The formal dining room has been opened up and transformed into a large open concept second living area that is ideal for entertaining. The chef's kitchen leads to an adjacent patio with direct access to the shared garden area and deck, the perfect place to entertain or just sit and enjoy the afternoon sun. This custom designed home offers a serene retreat in the heart of everything and is not to be missed.
